== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-tatooine-lars-moisture-farm/ swccgcards.com], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_TATOOINE_LARS_MOISTURE_FARM.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>3d8b97d299fa4f2257e2f87466e0f106cc8a4b2ae056437a49c07a09ed398dfd</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
